units.rawText: So they didn't directly attack this block? I can't believe it didn't collapse.

units.rawText: Erika looks out through the broken window. All she can see are ruins and stray fires. The shattered Sandbox Barrier symbolizes the total collapse of the Oasis' defense lines. Meanwhile, the Entropics pouring in from outside couldn't possibly be more at home as they devour the surviving agents and buildings.
